thread:
kevin: Quick thread: Customer C requires EU rollout to be opt-in only, plus an A/B comparing our int8 quantized model vs the baseline fp32. They explicitly requested an automated fallback that logs every step for compliance.

mina: They want per-tenant control and a clear billing delta; agreed to paid reserved slice if needed.

diego: Suggested rollout: shadowing -> 3% sample (A/B) -> 20% cohorts. Use tenant tag `eu_optin` to qualify. A/B assignment by hash of tenant id for deterministic bucketing.

aya: Ops constraints: EU cluster has grace capacity but we need a hard circuit that triggers on either p95>220ms OR token_burn > +20% vs baseline. If triggered, evict EU traffic in steps and emit `auto_eviction` audit events.

kevin: Proposed flag `eu_ab_quant_fp_v1` with states: off/shadow/ab/rollout. Policy: only `ab` samples opt-in-tagged tenants. Rollout to `rollout` requires KMS-bound tenants (for data residency).

diego: Pseudocode for sampling: ```
if flag == 'ab' and tenant_tagged('eu_optin'):
  bucket = hash(tenant_id) % 100
  variant = 'quant' if bucket < 50 else 'fp32'
else:
  variant = default
```

aya: Fallback ramp plan: steps = [75,50,25,0] percent EU weight, 1 min between steps. Emit audit event at each step with metrics snapshot. Also provide a `dry_run` mode for rehearsals that logs planned steps only.

mina: Customerops asks UI: tenant-level opt-out button + estimated monthly cost delta per tenant (rough P1). Also want immediate stop button (kill-switch) in Console.

kevin: GA gates: 5 days median p95 <200ms for sampled tenants, error rate <0.4%, auto_eviction events present, console toggle available.

diego: Engineering tasks: flag + AB controller + dry-run option + audit events. I'll own.

aya: SRE tasks: define circuit thresholds, implement eviction actuator, add alerts, publish runbook. I'll own runbook.

mina: I'll draft customer comms and pricing notes.

deploy-bot: ab-quant-controller v0.1 -> staging (build 6022) :rocket:

kevin: Risks: cold-start for quantized shards, recommend warmers during shadow and pre-warming before increasing weight. Also watch for model degradation differences; add quality checks.

diego: Will add prefix warmers and a lightweight quality regression eval in staging.

aya: We'll tag owners for postmortem if auto_eviction occurs. Runbook will include steps to rehydrate EU pool and verify KMS access.

kevin: Action items recap: @diego implement controller + dry-run + audit; @aya codify circuit + runbook; @mina customer comms and billing estimates. We'll reconvene after first dry-run.

deploy-bot: deployment completed to staging (6022) :white_check_mark:
